title: mentha longifolia var. calliantha
intro: Mentha longifolia var. calliantha, commonly known as Egyptian mint or long-leaved mint, is a variety of the spearmint plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia var. calliantha include its antispasmodic, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include rosmarinic acid, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
